checks: Define the target metric, assay, scale basis and constraints before proposing a route.

Verify precursor identity, relevant batch properties, reaction mechanism, order of addition, medium, concentration, pH, temperature and time when applicable; mark inapplicable fields rather than invent values.
Distinguish material synthesis from subsequent formulation, crosslinking, device fabrication and biological validation.
Preserve each route's conditions, purification, storage and characterization as a coherent evidence-backed chain.
Separate reported conditions, arithmetic scaling, extrapolations and experimental proposals.
Verify purification endpoints and fit-for-purpose characterization rather than treating elapsed time or appearance as proof.
Link every critical uncertainty to a discriminating experiment with controls, independent batches and a decision rule.
Select applicable hazard controls from primary safety information and local laboratory procedures; never invent a validated safety assessment.
